root_idea.summary: The supplied lexical evidence clusters around approaching or coming upon someone or something, and around a fastening or support that one holds to.
root_idea.development: The record extends from arrival, affliction, and approach to physical loops and handles, enduring pasture, and figurative support. No independent Maqāyīs or Mufradāt root-level account was supplied.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form VIII perfect citation form.
Displayed under the singular nominal citation form.

senses.definition: To come upon, befall, or seize someone.
senses.usage_conditions: A Form VIII use describing an event or affliction coming upon its object.

senses.definition: To afflict someone with possession or derangement; to render someone mentally unsound.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence presents this as an alleged affliction or possession by an evil influence.

senses.definition: The firmest handhold or support to which one clings or entrusts oneself.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression العُرْوَةُ الوُثْقَى, the term denotes the strongest means of holding fast, figuratively applied to firm religious commitment or support.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come to or approach someone, especially in search of beneficence, bounty, aid, or a gift; also, of guests, to come to a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I usage with a person as object; the approach may be ordinary or motivated by seeking assistance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an affair, event, malady, cold, or similar thing: to come upon, befall, or strike someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I usage in which the subject is an event, condition, or external influence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become affected by fever with shivering, or to tremble from fear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive or intransitive Form I usage describing the person affected.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To feel want of, or yearn toward, something after having parted with it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported in a figurative construction with إِلَى, especially of property sold or relinquished.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A fastening, loop, or loop-shaped handle by which something is secured or held, including those of garments, loads, vessels, and water-bags.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The literal physical sense includes a garment button-loop and the handles or fittings of various containers and loads.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To assign a palm tree to a needy person so that the person may eat its fruit for a period.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV transitive usage involving the grant or assignment of a palm tree and its fruit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leave a companion behind and withdraw without aiding him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported Form IV sense; the lexical source itself notes that it may instead belong to the related entry عَرَى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become fevered or affected by fever; to be affected by a cold night or experience evening cold.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive Form IV usage describing exposure to fever or cold.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To repair to, or make for, a region or quarter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical Form VIII directional use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of people: to eat fresh ripe dates in every direction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form X usage with the people as subject.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A region, quarter, or vicinity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal place-term; it can denote the area around or near a settlement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A yard, court, or open area around a dwelling or place of abode.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A place-term used in expressions for settling or alighting in a court or open area.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Free from disquiet, anxiety, or grief concerning an affair; at ease or unconcerned.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression أَنَا عِرْوٌ مِنْهُ means that one is free, or free in mind, from the matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A company or group of men.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Usually reported in the plural form أَعْرَاءٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Vehemence or intensity of cold.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use reported as originally related to عَرْوَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The external flesh or folds at the lower part of the female external genitalia.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical specialization; the paired structures are called عُرْوَتَانِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Vegetation or pasture that remains available during drought, especially enduring shrubs or trees on which livestock feed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may denote drought-surviving pasture, persistent shrubs, or dense trees among which camels or other livestock feed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The environs of a town where people pasture their cattle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A place-term for the surrounding grazing area of a settlement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A company or party of people from whom one benefits or profits.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative plural use likening such people to enduring vegetation that provides sustenance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Something held in high estimation or much request, such as an excellent animal or other prized property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative singular use applied to valuable camels, cattle, horses, or comparable property.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stay or support for poor or needy people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic figurative expression for a person or thing on which the needy rely.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A name or epithet for the lion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexicalized nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tremor or shivering, especially the onset of fever; also the trembling inspired in others by the coming of a hero.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The heroic extension is reported as an attributed Classical usage; the ordinary sense concerns shivering or the first access of fever.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The low voice or growl of a lion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal animal-related use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The interval from the sun's yellowing until nightfall, associated with the onset of cold and a northerly or north wind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A time and weather term for the cooling period between late day and night.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An epithet for a palm tree of the type called عَرِيَّةٌ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival or nominal epithet applied to the tree.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cold wind; also, a cold evening or night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally or nominally of cold weather and the wind associated with it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A palm tree assigned by its owner to another, especially a needy person, so that the recipient may eat its fruit for a year.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is also associated with a palm tree excluded from ordinary fruit-bargaining or from which the fruit has been taken or scattered, according to reported explanations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A type of basket made from palm leaves for carrying dates and similar goods.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate nominal use from the palm-tree sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plant, especially one whose leaves do not fall in winter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plant name with an evergreen or winter-persistent characterization.
